database_basis: Isolated var/ui-checks database; not user application state
checks: First visit explains the factory process, product purpose and user-controlled fictional data
Normal selector excludes test fixtures; preserved earlier records remain accessible
Selected cap batch creates an actual paused experiment without generating outcomes
All four tabs state what to enter, what to do and what it achieves
User-selected expired reference keeps passing-looking readings unusable
Different readings are saved individually; valid torque does not invent a leak result
Elapsed time and independent FAIL are explicitly chosen and persisted
Problem, explanation, approved change and fresh verification remain separate actions
Review notes have a specific purpose and editable example; permission stays explicitly bounded
User chooses sample count and only permitted units are recorded
History explains entered data and preserves an earlier failed decision
Saved experiment and outcomes survive reload
All four tabs fit 1024 px without document overflow
All four tabs fit 390 px without document overflow
Custom batch identity and machine setting are user-chosen and do not inherit old proof
A different cap batch can remain covered; new does not automatically mean bad
